state.scope: Public open-source personal offline workout PWA. Judge only this supplied public summary. You have not inspected the repository, images, videos, application, or devices. External professional approval is outside this release scope; do not infer validated exercise form.

release.qaSummary: Independent QA pending; no pass is claimed.
release.newLiveVerification: Not yet verified. Previous v24 live verification is separate evidence.

state.movement: 19 unique local AI PNG sheets, each 4x4 with 16 frames, represented by 20 catalog entries. 45 of 73 exact programmed names have a guide; 28 missing; zero complete real videos. Four new images in this increment, including prone Y and T raises. Regular and slow T share artwork but have separate 3-second and 4-second catalog playback. AI illustrations are labeled as such, with slow/scrub/replay controls. Some pose and scale drift remains; full motion-form correctness is not established. Dead bug was rejected after two repairs because opposite-limb pairing remained unclear.
state.help: In-app help pauses a workout and retains exercise and seconds. Reload restores a paused checkpoint. Boss HRP/plank and unsaved results restore paused; no background time counted; interrupted tests are labeled segmented. Slow image downloads show a 15-second hint and fail after 120 seconds; stale callbacks are cleaned. Previous v24 live verification loaded and scrubbed three guides. iPhone eviction and physical-device behavior remain unverified.
state.timing: Workout timing uses repetitions times tempo, holds, rests, preparation and transitions. Regular prone T guide has a 3-second cycle, slow T has a separate 4-second cycle. Plank middle frames are prolonged to show a hold; actual hold duration follows workout timer. Animation timing illustrates movement and is not an individualized prescription.
state.program: Two push days, two lower-body exposures, two pull exposures, one recovery day, and Boss day. Foot-anchored band only. No-band upper-back movement is not equivalent to loaded pulling. Bounded per-movement progression uses the prior 28 days of exact variants: two completed dates with every required work set easy at current target increase one repetition, capped at base+2 and variant ceiling. Negative feedback resets baseline even on unfinished days; today excluded; deload gets no addition; active checkpoint dose remains fixed. Variants and sides are independent; repeated sets count one day; missing ordinals or duplicate IDs do not qualify. Prior v24 live verification showed actual push11/press10 targets. Actual band resistance and range of motion are not tracked, and weekly volume is not automatically adjusted.
state.navigation: Today shows next action; active/current/next/progress/help/pause/exit are available; mobile sticky return remains visible. Target cards show baseline, current repetitions and reason. No independent user study. Current increment QA and full CI status are recorded under release; prior live checks must not be presented as verification of this increment.
